title: The Secret Army That Fooled Hitler With Fake Tanks
description:
The 23rd Headquarters Special Troops, nicknamed the Ghost Army, used inflatable tanks, fake radio traffic, and sound trucks to trick the German army about Allied troop positions in WWII.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
